def upload_collection_configs(self, collection, fs_path):
        """
        Uploads collection configurations from a specified directory to zookeeper. 

        """
        if not os.path.exists(fs_path):
            raise Exception("Configurations directory %s does not exist" % fs_path)
        if not os.path.isdir(fs_path):
            raise Exception("Configurations directory %s is not a directory" % fs_path)

        # get the collection configs
        collection_configs = self.get_collection_configs(collection)

        # get the collection configs from the specified directory
        collection_configs_from_dir = self.get_collection_configs_from_dir(fs_path)

        # merge the collection configs from the specified directory with the existing collection configs
        collection_configs = self.merge_collection_configs(collection_configs, collection_configs_from_dir)

        # upload the merged collection configs to zookeeper
        self.upload_collection_configs(collection, collection_configs)
